title: PDS Tool Manifest
description: Workflow-scoped tool manifest for the Progressive Discovery Spine. One manifest describes one semantic-entity tool an agent can discover and call. Formalizes PDS principle #1 (semantic-entity tools), #2 (workflow-scoped packs), and #7 (tenant-scoped gateway).

name.description: Semantic entity name (e.g. search_open_pos), not a raw API endpoint.

version.description: SemVer. The index keeps prior versions active until the new embedding is indexed.

intent_examples.description: Natural-language phrasings embedded alongside the description so intent matches discovery.

parameters.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input parameters.

returns.description: Shape of the composed response envelope the tool returns.

sla.description: Machine-readable SLA so the agent can route around degradation.
